decisions.reason: Having survived the first review while similar 2023 launches were pruned, the serum now looks like a reasonably validated, low-cost adjacent option that is still worth keeping unless demand clearly weakens.

As a close-to-core product launched only in 2024, the cleansing oil remains an inexpensive option to keep open while the firm learns more about demand, though a small firm could still drop it if it fails to gain traction.
